Trigger.note: Resting trigger: leading icon (sized icon-paired by the consumer, as GeneralPane does), truncating label, muted chevron, 32px outline button at the default 240px width.

InSettingsRows.note: Two menus in their real habitat — right-aligned controls in SettingsRows at the shared w-60 control width.

Open.note: Opened surface shows the whole menu contract: group labels, per-option icons and detail lines, the Check on the selected option, a disabled option, and the divider between groups on the popover fill.
